name: cooling_tower_chiller_variable_airflow
title: Cooling tower of a chiller plant with variable air flow (revision exercise)
summary: Steady cooling-tower model coupled to a water chiller: counter-flow effectiveness-NTU tower with saturated outlet air, fan laws scaling pressure rise and dry UA with the air mass flow, chiller COP as a function of the condenser water temperature, and the plant global COP; the air flow is the operating input.

origin.course: ULiege MSTh revision session, repetition TP 10 (JL051223, 2005-12-23, series 04-06)

verification.summary: Compared with the solution stored in Revision JL051223-05.EES (42 valued variables) at its stored operating point M_dot_a = 30 kg/s: compare_solution.py reports 42 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); max relative difference 3.84e-04 (v_a, humid-air backend). The nominal point of the file's stored comment block (M_dot_a = 10.51) is reproduced within its 4-digit rounding.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/.../TP 10/Revision JL051223-05.EES (candidate TM-0162, 42/47 stored variables valued)
verification.notes: Stored reference is the last run of parametric Table 1 (W_dot_fan sweep, 120 rows), i.e. M_dot_a = 30 kg/s through the fan law. Solved unmodified first: 41 equations / 42 unknowns (System square: No); the input equation M_dot_a = 30 completes what the EES parametric table supplied. Excluded (no stored value, commented equations): a, b, c, d, AU_dry_ct. Largest differences: v_a 3.84e-04 (EES 0.8461153457 vs CoolSolve 0.84579047 m^3/kg, humid-air backend), propagating to V_dot_a and W_dot_fan (116314.328 vs 116269.668 W). Solver: 3 iterations with the stored guesses; without .initials the 16-variable block fails SingularJacobian. Secondary check at M_dot_a = 10.51 against the file's stored comment block: W_dot_fan 4999.3 vs 5000 W (1.4e-04), t_w_ex_ct 29.7156 vs 29.72 C, COP_global 3.6803 vs 3.68. Units were already SI MASS DEG PA C J. .sol labels v_a as kg/m^3 (CS-BUG-UNIT-VOLUME, values unaffected).
